title: Tackle Low Drive Through In Italian (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica steel guitar fiddle italian accordion accent
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
Son, I am going to teach the tackle in Italian today
I have never been to Italy
But I hear they know a thing or two about contact sport
And pasta

[Verse 1]
Low body position, eyes on the hips
Drive through the contact, let nothing slip
Shoulder into the carrier, arms wrap tight
Low tackle drive through, done right

[Italian Verse]
Posizione bassa, occhi sui fianchi
Spalla nel portatore, braccia non stanchi
Guida attraverso il contatto, tieni il basso
Tackle basso e avanti, questo e il passo

[Chas reacts spoken]
Now I do not speak Italian son
But that sounded exactly like what I have been telling you
Low. Eyes on the hips. Drive through.
The Italians know their stuff

[Chorus]
Tackle low drive through, eyes on the hips
Spalla nel portatore, nothing slips
Low body position, arms wrap tight
Tackle basso e avanti, done right

[Verse 2]
Never go high in a tackle zone
High tackle gives away the phone
Low and through, shoulder leads the way
Tackle low drive through, every day

[Italian Bridge]
Non andare mai alto nel contrasto
Basso e avanti, questo non e un guasto
Spalla davanti, braccia stringi forte
Tackle basso sempre, questa e la sorte

[Chas spoken]
You see son, in any language
Low is always right
Low in Italian, low in English
Low in any country on earth

[Chorus]
Tackle low drive through, eyes on the hips
Spalla nel portatore, nothing slips
Low body position, arms wrap tight
Tackle basso e avanti, done right

[Outro]
Basso, figlio mio
That means low son
Thats my boy
